commands.tooLarge: The saved commands file is too large: %1

tunnel.hint: Tunnels cannot ask for passwords. Add your key to ssh-agent and connect once in a terminal to trust the host.
tunnel.vanished: The tunnel closed right after it started.
tunnel.ambiguous: Several matching ssh processes were found, so none was tracked.
tunnel.noForwards: This host has no port forwards in your SSH config.
tunnel.conflict: A tunnel for this host is already running under another configuration.
tunnel.limit: Too many tunnels are running (the limit is 64). Stop one first.
editor.disabled: Hosts can only be added here when the default SSH config is used.
editor.setup: Hosts you add are saved in omassh.config. ssh reads it once an Include line is added to ~/.ssh/config. Press n to set it up.

editor.waiting.one: %1 host in omassh.config is waiting for the Include line
editor.waiting.other: %1 hosts in omassh.config are waiting for the Include line

editor.late: The Include line (%1, line %2) has other settings above it, which override the hosts added here. Press n to add it at the top.
editor.scoped: The Include line (%1, line %2) is inside a Host or Match block, so ssh reads it only for some hosts. Press n to add it at the top.
editor.foreign: omassh.config was edited by hand, so the panel leaves it alone.
editor.unsafe: The panel leaves omassh.config alone because %1.
editor.unsafeMode: ssh refuses omassh.config because other users can write to it. Run: chmod 600 ~/.ssh/omassh.config
editor.incomplete: Part of your SSH config could not be read (an Include was skipped or a size limit was reached), so the panel cannot tell which names are free. Adding and editing hosts is off.
editor.reason.notRegular: it is not a regular file
editor.reason.dir: ~/.ssh is not a private folder owned by you
editor.keys: Tab next · Shift+Tab back · ↵ save · Esc cancel
field.forwardsHelp: L local · R remote · D dynamic (SOCKS)
error.invalidAlias: Start with a letter or digit, then use letters, digits, . _ or -.
error.invalidHostname: Use a host name or an IP address, without brackets.
error.invalidUser: Use letters, digits, . _ or -, and do not start with -.
error.invalidIdentityFile: Use an absolute path or one starting with ~/, without spaces.
error.taken: This name is already used in your SSH config.
error.self: A host cannot jump through itself.
error.forward: Use L 8080 localhost:80, R 9000 localhost:22 or D 1080.
error.cycle: These jump hosts lead back to this host.
save.tunnelRestart: Saved %1. Restart its tunnel to use the new forwards.
save.tunnelUp: Stop the tunnel of %1 before renaming the host.
save.conflict: This host changed on disk. Close the form and open it again.
save.notIncluded: ssh does not read omassh.config first yet. Close the form and add the Include line.
save.incomplete: Part of your SSH config could not be read, so the panel cannot tell whether this name is free. Nothing was saved.
save.notManaged: This host is not stored in omassh.config, so it cannot be changed here.
delete.confirmTunnel: Delete %1 from omassh.config? Its running tunnel will be stopped.
setup.title: Add the Include line
setup.explain: ssh reads omassh.config only after ~/.ssh/config has an Include line for it. This adds one line at the top, above every setting:
setup.create: %1 does not exist yet. It will be created with this line:
setup.backup: A backup of the file is saved first. Close ~/.ssh/config in your editor before you continue.
setup.acl: Its access control list (ACL) will be kept when the file is replaced.
setup.manual: Add this line at the top of %1 yourself:
setup.changed: Added the line to %1. Your old file is saved as %2.
setup.late: The Include line (%1, line %2) has other settings above it, which override the hosts added here. Enter adds it at the top.
setup.scoped: The Include line (%1, line %2) is inside a Host or Match block, so ssh reads it only for some hosts. Enter adds it at the top.
setup.refused.mode: Other users can write to %1, so ssh would refuse it.
setup.refused.links: %1 has other hard links, so it cannot be replaced safely.
setup.refused.dir: The folder of %1 is not safe to write to.
setup.refused.bom: %1 starts with a byte order mark.
setup.refused.group: %1 belongs to a group you are not in, so a new file could not keep its group.
setup.refused.acl: The access control list of %1 could not be kept.
setup.refused.managedUnsafe: omassh.config is not safe to use. Fix that first.
setup.refused.managedForeign: omassh.config was edited by hand, so ssh could refuse it. Fix or remove it first; adding the line now could break every host.
